messages:
Olivia Park: quick sync  we have inconsistent terminology around rollout language in docs and SDKs: 'canary', 'canary rollout', 'partial rollout', and 'A/B test' all used in different pages. want to standardize before the next release.
Ravi Menon: +1. proposal: use 'rollout' as the umbrella term, 'canary' as a specific rollout strategy, and 'A/B test' only when we mean measured split experiments. eg: 'Start a canary rollout to validate a model variant' vs 'Run an A/B test to compare metrics'.
Sasha Green: agree. also flagging SDK examples that use a boolean `canary=True` param. booleans lack expressivity for future strategies (e.g., phased, weighted). suggest `rollout_strategy` string enum instead: "none" | "canary" | "weighted".
Olivia Park: good point. SDK rename will touch lots of snippets. recommended public surface: `rollout_strategy` + optional `rollout_config` object for weights/duration. migration plan: keep `canary=True` as a shim that maps to `rollout_strategy='canary'` for 6 months, with a deprecation warning.
Ravi Menon: sample shim for python migration note (to include in /docs/migration/rollouts.md):
```python
# shim for v2 -> v3
if kwargs.pop('canary', False):
    kwargs.setdefault('rollout_strategy', 'canary')
```
Olivia Park: thanks. docs action items: 1) glossary entry for 'rollout', 'canary', 'weighted rollout', 2) update SDK snippets across /docs/sdk/*, 3) migration doc with code shims, 4) add docs-lint rule to flag `canary=True` occurrences. who takes what?
Sasha Green: I will update SDK snippets (JS + Python) and include both camelCase/snake_case examples. I'll open PR for snippets by Tue.
Ravi Menon: i'll own the glossary and redirects for older terms like 'partial rollout' -> 'rollout'. will add synonyms in frontmatter: search_synonyms: ["partial rollout", "canary rollout"].
Olivia Park: i'll write the migration doc and the short changelog blurb. i'll include sample code diffs and the deprecation warning text: "Deprecated: boolean 'canary' param will be removed in 6 months. Use 'rollout_strategy' instead."
DocsBot: Auto: created issue #1265 "docs: standardize rollout terminology + SDK param rename" (https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/1265).
Sasha Green: small note on wording: in product UI we currently display 'Canary' as a menu item. we'll keep that but change help text to be "Canary rollout (validate changes on a subset of traffic)" so it maps to docs language. i've filed a tiny frontend PR to update the tooltip.
Ravi Menon: also add an example sentence for the docs style guide: "When referring to deployment strategies, use 'rollout' as the noun and 'rollout_strategy' as the SDK param. Example: Start a canary rollout for the new model variant." I'll add it to /docs/style/terminology.md.
Olivia Park: timeline check: snippets PR by Tue, glossary + redirects by Wed, migration doc + changelog by Thu, lint rule by next sprint. if any blockers ping here.
Sasha Green: one more nit: avoid mixing 'model variant' and 'model version' in the rollout docs. decide: 'variant' for runtime/compile differences, 'version' for semantic model updates. will add a short parenthetical in rollout doc to clarify.
Ravi Menon: good call. i'll include that in glossary entry.
Olivia Park: perfect. closing thread once PRs merged. thanks :rocket:
